pages.text: Base cost: 35. Cooldown: 7s. Base radius 3 blocks for 10 seconds. Requires suitable ground.
Hold R to select. Tap G for slot 1 or hold G for about 0.4 seconds for slot 2. Alternate forms add 4 concentration; each cost upgrade saves 2. Signs are disabled in official bouts.
Three traps: Place small traps beside the main trap on safe ground.
Pulsing trap: Deal double base pulse damage.
